other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Stacking via Calibration
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calibrates out-of-fold (OOF) predictions using the validation targets, and then uses these calibrated predictions to optimize ensemble weights on the exact same targets. This causes data leakage because the predictions have already incorporated information from the targets they are being evaluated against, leading to biased and overfitted ensemble weights.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and generally excellent solution, implementing advanced feature engineering, a well-regularized neural network, and properly scoped cross-validation without violating the core data science principles. The only notable issue is a subtle target leakage during ensembling, where out-of-fold predictions are calibrated on the validation targets before being used to fit the ensemble weights on those same targets.
